info.title: Citadel library API
info.description: Utoipa's axum bindings for seamless integration for the two

get.description: The signed-in user's saved provider keys. Keys themselves are never returned.

put.description: Check a provider key with the provider, then save it for the signed-in user, replacing any earlier key.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: A provider that needs a key

delete.description: Forget the signed-in user's key for a provider.
Delete an author with no books.

post.description: Permanently delete books and their files; this can't be undone. Nothing is deleted if any ID is unknown. Folders that could not be removed are listed, relative to the library, in folder_failures.
Query the configured library. HTTP requires an explicit limit between 0 and 200; zero returns only the total. No arbitrary library paths are accepted.

get.description: Cached thumbnails only. The bounded in-memory index is rebuilt on demand after a restart.
Look one provider up by ISBN. No match is an empty list, not an error.
Metadata providers and whether the signed-in user can use each. Keyless providers are always available.

post.description: Check that the server can reach a provider, with the user's own key when it needs one.

get.description: Free-text search one provider. No results is an empty list, not an error. Answers are cached briefly; uncached lookups count against a per-user rate limit.
The signed-in user, or 401 when the browser has no valid session.

post.description: Sign in with a Citadel username and password. Sets an HttpOnly session cookie.

delete.description: End this browser's session and clear its cookie.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Byte offset of this chunk; must equal receivedBytes

requestBody.description: The next bytes of the file, at most chunkBytes

BookCustomValue.description: One book's value for one custom column.

BookMetadata.description:
A book record from a provider. Providers return these fully populated from a
single search call — there is no separate resolve step, so the cover-less
MARC sources' subjects/publisher/language survive into the applied record.

genre_candidates.description:
Explicit provider genre/form terms. Subject headings are never placed
here merely because they look genre-like.

language_code.description: MARC 3-letter language code. Parsed now; applied once CDL-2 lands.

provider_id.description:
Provider-native id: hardcover id (stringified), LCCN, DNB control
number, or Open Library OLID.

slug.description: Hardcover deep-link slug; `None` for other providers.

subjects.description: Subject headings, mapped to tag suggestions on the frontend.

CommitUpload.description: The metadata the user reviewed, to add the upload to the library with.

identifier.description:
Stored as the book's ISBN when it is one (`urn:isbn:` and `ISBN:`
prefixes are accepted); other identifiers are ignored.

fileName.description: The file's name, which decides its format by extension.

size.description: The file's total size in bytes.

CustomColumnDef.description: A custom column definition, as exposed to the frontend.

enum_values.description: Allowed values for enumeration columns. Empty for other datatypes.

label.description: Lookup name, e.g. `read` (Calibre exposes it as `#read`).

supported.description: Whether reading and writing values of this column is supported.

CustomValueDto.description:
A custom-column value crossing the application boundary.

Mirrors `libcalibre::CustomValue`, except datetimes travel as RFC3339
strings and integers as `i32` (specta cannot export `i64` without bigint
support).

source.description:
Stable provider field identity, such as `hardcover:genre` or
`marc:655`.

vocabulary.description: Provider vocabulary or thesaurus when one is declared.

Identifier.description: Book identifiers, such as ISBN, DOI, Google Books ID, etc.

book_count.description:
Number of books in the library linked to this author, from
`Library::author_book_counts` (one GROUP BY pass over
`books_authors_link`). The Authors page renders this directly
instead of deriving counts from the whole book list.

language_list.description:
Canonical Calibre language codes (ISO 639-2/3, e.g. `eng`, `fra`),
ordered. Empty when the book has no language metadata.

total.description: Total number of books matching the filters, ignoring limit/offset.

text.description:
Substring match across title, author names, and series names.
`None` or empty text matches all books.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file. Common values are `application/pdf` and `application/epub+zip`.

path.description: The absolute path to the file, including extension.

MetadataProvider.description:
The metadata sources Citadel can look books up against. The serialized
short form is the single id used across the Rust enum, the TS string union,
and the frontend registry keys.

available.description: Whether this user can look books up with the provider right now.

accountName.description: The provider account the key belongs to, when the provider says.

createdAt.description: When the key was saved, in Unix seconds.

needsReentry.description:
The server can no longer read the key (its vault key changed); enter
it again.

verifiedAt.description: When the provider last accepted the key, in Unix seconds.

secret.description: The provider API key. It is checked with the provider before saving.

libraryAccess.description: False when the user exists but has no access to this server's library.

StagedBook.description: What the uploaded file says about itself, for the user to review.

format.description: The file's format, as its extension (`epub`, `azw3`, …).

title.description: The file's own title, or its name when it has none.

oneOf.description: Present once every byte has arrived and the file has been read.
